name: @w6w-apps/wise
description: Send cross-border transfers with Wise: quotes, recipients, transfers, and multi-currency balances.

w6w.longDescription:
Wise (formerly TransferWise) moves money across borders at close to the real exchange rate. This app covers the path most Wise automations need: create a quote for a currency pair, attach or create a recipient account, turn the quote into a transfer, fund it from a multi-currency balance, and track its status through to completion.

Beyond the send-money path it also surfaces profile management, live and historical exchange rates, the full currency list, and balance/statement reads for reconciliation.

Wise's Personal API Token is documented as a business-account feature with a closed, stated scope (quotes, recipients, transfers, tracking) that does not fully match what its own API reference declares per endpoint — this app documents that gap rather than guessing past it. Two write actions (funding a transfer, reading a balance statement) are Strong Customer Authentication (SCA) protected outside a short list of countries, and are documented as such.
